episode.intent: List the names of schools with more than 30 difference in enrollements between K-12 and ages 5-17? Please also give the full street adress of the schools.

episode.failed_sql:
SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       TRIM(
         COALESCE(s.Street,'') ||
         CASE WHEN s.StreetAbr IS NOT NULL AND s.StreetAbr<>'' THEN ' ' || s.StreetAbr ELSE '' END ||
         CASE WHEN s.City IS NOT NULL AND s.City<>'' THEN ', ' || s.City ELSE '' END ||
         CASE WHEN s.State IS NOT NULL AND s.State<>'' THEN ', ' || s.State ELSE '' END ||
         CASE WHEN s.Zip IS NOT NULL AND s.Zip<>'' THEN ' ' || s.Zip ELSE '' END
       ) AS address
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE ABS((f."Enrollment (K-12)") - (f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")) > 30;
episode.remediation_sql:
SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       TRIM(
         COALESCE(NULLIF(s.Street,''), NULLIF(s.StreetAbr,'')) ||
         CASE WHEN s.City IS NOT NULL AND s.City<>'' THEN ', ' || s.City ELSE '' END ||
         CASE WHEN s.State IS NOT NULL AND s.State<>'' THEN ', ' || s.State ELSE '' END ||
         CASE WHEN s.Zip IS NOT NULL AND s.Zip<>'' THEN ' ' || s.Zip ELSE '' END
       ) AS address
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE ABS((f."Enrollment (K-12)") - (f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")) > 30;
